shortDescription: Moroccan pharmaceutical company Laprophan's initial public offering was seven times oversubscribed, reflecting strong investor demand for the largest listing on the Casablanca Stock Exchange this year, the IPO's lead manager said on Thursday.

children: Moroccan pharmaceutical company Laprophan's initial public offering was seven times oversubscribed, reflecting strong investor demand for the largest listing on the Casablanca Stock Exchange this year, the IPO's lead manager said on Thursday.

Investors submitted orders worth 15.3 billion dirhams ($1.5 billion) for an offer seeking to raise 2.22 billion dirhams, according to final estimates from Bachir Tazi, executive director at CFG Bank, the IPO's lead manager
The offer attracted 44,000 subscribers, with final results due to be formally announced on November 25, he said
The IPO, Morocco's third this year, combines the sale of a mix of new and existing shares
Laprophan, which operates four industrial sites in Morocco and Switzerland, reported revenue of 1.82 billion dirhams ($180 million) in 2025, up from 1.638 billion dirhams a year earlier

The IPO is intended to support expansion plans, including the acquisition of Polymedic, another Moroccan pharmaceutical company that generated revenue of about 405 million dirhams in 2025, subject to regulatory approval
